name: Tile grid (waffle)
purpose: A waffle grid of tiles that change state in a fixed or seeded order (n of 100 people, share of servers down), with only the tiles that change animating, in order.

inputs.name: order
inputs.description: reading | column | centre | seeded (Studio.rng(seed)) | explicit indices

implementation.api: Studio.comp.tileGrid(parent, {count, columns, states, initial, order, seed, gap, round}) -> {enter(tl, at), to(tl, {state: n, ...}, at, {stagger, duration}), counts(), exit(tl, at)}; call to() in time order

layout_notes: CSS grid that fills its parent's width; tile gap in --u; columns per format through Studio.pick.
validation_steps: python tests/test-studio-runtime.py (seeded order is deterministic, counts after each change, backward and forward seeks agree)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-24. Not rendered through HyperFrames.
